description: This Java source file defines the Listener class for the OpenMRS web application. It manages startup and shutdown processes, including loading modules, initializing the Spring context, handling web requests, setting properties, managing CSRF protection, and performing cleanup. It acts as the central orchestrator for starting and stopping the web application, ensuring proper initialization, error handling, and resource management.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: The Listener class manages the lifecycle of the OpenMRS web application, handling initialization and destruction events. It orchestrates module loading, context setup, configuration, error handling, and resource cleanup during startup and shutdown. Implements interfaces ServletContextListener and HttpSessionListener to respond to web container events.

methods.name: sessionCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of an HTTP session; forwards the event to registered HttpSessionListener beans.

methods.name: sessionDestroyed
methods.description: Handles the destruction of an HTTP session; forwards the event to registered HttpSessionListener beans.

methods.name: getHttpSessionListeners
methods.description: Retrieves all registered HttpSessionListener components from the Spring context.

methods.name: contextInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the web application context upon startup, performs configuration, loads modules, sets properties, and starts OpenMRS; handles errors and sets flags accordingly.

methods.name: loadCsrfGuardProperties
methods.description: Loads CSRF protection properties from configuration files, configures CSRFGuard, and sets servlet context for security.

methods.name: setupNeeded
methods.description: Determines if database setup or migrations are required before starting OpenMRS.

methods.name: startOpenmrs
methods.description: Performs the startup sequence for OpenMRS, including module loading, context initialization, and scheduling.

methods.name: loadConstants
methods.description: Loads startup constants from web.xml into WebConstants.

methods.name: setApplicationDataDirectory
methods.description: Sets the application data directory based on configuration or defaults.

methods.name: getContextPath
methods.description: Returns the web application's context path without the leading slash.

methods.name: clearDWRFile
methods.description: Resets the DWR module configuration file to prevent loading errors.

methods.name: copyCustomizationIntoWebapp
methods.description: Copies custom templates, images, and pages into the web application directories based on runtime properties.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Helper method to copy files from source to destination paths.

methods.name: loadBundledModules
methods.description: Loads modules packaged within the web application's bundledModules directory.

methods.name: contextDestroyed
methods.description: Cleans up resources, shuts down modules, deregisters drivers, and performs garbage collection upon web application shutdown.

methods.name: getRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Retrieves runtime properties for the application.

methods.name: performWebStartOfModules
methods.description: Starts all modules and performs necessary web context refreshes.

methods.name: performWebStartOfModules
methods.description: Overloaded method to start a specified collection of modules.

methods.name: getActualRootCause
methods.description: Recursively finds the deepest cause of an exception.
